question: 对比下不同渠道销售额情况
gold_sql: select c.channel_name, sum(o.total_amount) from orders o left join channels c on o.channel_id = c.channel_id where o.status = '已完成' group by 1
raw_output:
SELECT c.channel_name,
       SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN channels c ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
